```sql
SELECT 
  sp.priority,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN te.event_type = 'resolution' AND te.event_at - te.ticket_opened_at > sp.resolution_hours * INTERVAL '1 hour' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS breach_count,
  COUNT(te.event_type = 'resolution') AS total_resolutions,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN te.event_type = 'resolution' AND te.event_at - te.ticket_opened_at > sp.resolution_hours * INTERVAL '1 hour' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) * 1.0 / COUNT(te.event_type = 'resolution') AS breach_rate
FROM 
  support.sla_policies sp
JOIN 
  support.tickets t ON sp.tenant_id = t.tenant_id
JOIN 
  support.ticket_events te ON t.ticket_id = te.ticket_id
WHERE 
  te.event_type = 'resolution'
GROUP BY 
  sp.priority;
```
RULES_APPLIED: 1, 2, 3, 4

```sql
WITH VirtualSchools AS (
    SELECT 
        s.County,
        s.School,
        AVG(sats.AvgScrRead) AS AvgReadScore
    FROM 
        schools s
    LEFT JOIN 
        satscores sats ON s.CDSCode = sats.cds
    WHERE 
        s.Virtual = 1
    GROUP BY 
        s.County, s.School
),
RankedVirtualSchools AS (
    SELECT 
        County,
        COUNT(School) AS VirtualSchoolCount,
        MAX(AvgReadScore) AS MaxAvgReadScore
    FROM 
        VirtualSchools
    GROUP BY 
        County
),
TopCounties AS (
    SELECT 
        County,
        VirtualSchoolCount,
        MaxAvgReadScore
    FROM 
        RankedVirtualSchools
    ORDER BY 
        VirtualSchoolCount DESC
    LIMIT 5
),
CountyDetails AS (
    SELECT 
        r.County,
        r.VirtualSchoolCount,
        r.MaxAvgReadScore,
        vs.School,
        vs.AvgReadScore
    FROM 
        RankedVirtualSchools r
    LEFT JOIN 
        VirtualSchools vs ON r.County = vs.County AND r.MaxAvgReadScore = vs.AvgReadScore
)
SELECT 
    County,
    VirtualSchoolCount,
    COALESCE(School, 'None') AS HighestAvgReadSchool
FROM 
    CountyDetails
ORDER BY 
    VirtualSchoolCount DESC;
```

```sql
WITH district_info AS (
    SELECT

        d.A2 AS district_name,
        d.region,
        MAX(CASE WHEN t.date <= '1996-12-31' THEN t.balance ELSE 0 END) AS end_of_1996_balance
    FROM 
        district d
    JOIN 
        disp disp ON d.district_id = disp.district_id
    JOIN 
        account acc ON disp.account_id = acc.account_id
    JOIN 
        trans t ON acc.account_id = t.account_id
    WHERE 
        acc.issued LIKE '1996%'
    GROUP BY 
        d.district_id, d.A2, d.region
),
region_average AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(end_of_1996_balance) AS region_avg_balance
    FROM 
        district_info
)
SELECT 
    district_name,
    COUNT(account_id) AS num_accounts_opened,
    ROUND(AVG(end_of_1996_balance), 2) AS avg_end_of_1996_balance,
    (SELECT region_avg_balance FROM region_average) AS region_avg_balance,
    (SELECT district_name FROM district_info ORDER BY avg_end_of_1996_balance DESC, district_name ASC LIMIT 1) AS highest_avg_balance_district
FROM 
    district_info
ORDER BY 
    district_name;
```

```sql
WITH district_pop AS (
    SELECT
        d.district_id,
        d.A2,
        COUNT(c.client_id) AS num_clients
    FROM
        district d
    LEFT JOIN
        client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id
    GROUP BY
        d.district_id, d.A2
    ORDER BY
        num_clients DESC, d.A2 COLLATE NOCASE
    LIMIT 3
),
crime_counts AS (
    SELECT
        d.district_id,
        COUNT(o.order_id) AS num_crimes
    FROM
        district d
    LEFT JOIN
        account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    LEFT JOIN
        `order` o ON a.account_id = o.account_id
    WHERE
        o.date BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY
        d.district_id
),
overall_avg AS (
    SELECT
        AVG(COALESCE(num_crimes, 0)) AS avg_crimes
    FROM
        crime_counts
)
SELECT
    dp.A2 AS district_name,
    dp.num_clients AS population,
    cc.num_crimes AS num_crimes,
    ROUND(ov.avg_crimes, 2) AS avg_crimes_overall,
    ROUND(dp.num_clients * cc.num_crimes / 1000000.0, 2) AS avg_crimes_per_million,
    ROUND(dp.num_clients * cc.num_crimes / 1000000.0 - ov.avg_crimes, 2) AS diff
FROM
    district_pop dp
JOIN
    crime_counts cc ON dp.district_id = cc.district_id
CROSS JOIN
    overall_avg ov;
```

```sql
SELECT
```

```sql
         WHEN s.Charter = 0 THEN 'No' 
         ELSE 'Unknown' 
    END AS Charter,
    s.GSserved AS GradesServed,
    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(sats.AvgScrRead, sats.AvgScrMath, sats.AvgScrWrite) IS NULL THEN 'No SAT Data'
        WHEN sats.AvgScrRead + sats.AvgScrMath + sats.AvgScrWrite < 1200 THEN 'Below Average'
        WHEN sats.AvgScrRead + sats.AvgScrMath + sats.AvgScrWrite BETWEEN 1200 AND 1500 THEN 'Average'
        ELSE 'Above Average'
    END AS SATPerformanceLevel
FROM 
    frpm f
JOIN 
    schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN 
    satscores sats ON f.CDSCode = sats.cds
WHERE 
    f.`High Grade` = '12' AND s.GSserved LIKE '%12%'
```

```sql
WITH VirtualSchools AS (
    SELECT 
        s.County,
        s.School,
        AVG(sats.AvgScrRead) AS AvgReadingScore
    FROM 
        schools s
    LEFT JOIN 
        satscores sats ON s.CDSCode = sats.cds
    WHERE 
        s.Virtual = 'F'
    GROUP BY 
        s.County, s.School
),
RankedVirtualSchools AS (
    SELECT 
        County,
        COUNT(School) AS VirtualSchoolCount,
        MAX(AvgReadingScore) AS MaxReadingScore
    FROM 
        VirtualSchools
    GROUP BY 
        County
),
TopCounties AS (
    SELECT 
        County,
        VirtualSchoolCount,
        MaxReadingScore
    FROM 
        RankedVirtualSchools
    ORDER BY 
        VirtualSchoolCount DESC
    LIMIT 5
),
TopVirtualSchools AS (
    SELECT 
        v.County,
        v.School,
        v.AvgReadingScore
    FROM 
        VirtualSchools v
    JOIN 
        TopCounties tc ON v.County = tc.County
    WHERE 
        v.AvgReadingScore = tc.MaxReadingScore
)
SELECT 
    tc.County,
    tc.VirtualSchoolCount,
    COALESCE(TVS.School, 'None') AS HighestReadingSchool
FROM 
    TopCounties tc
LEFT JOIN 
    TopVirtualSchools TVS ON tc.County = TVS.County AND tc.MaxReadingScore = TVS.AvgReadingScore
ORDER BY 
    tc.VirtualSchoolCount DESC;
```

```sql
WITH central_bohemia AS (

    FROM district d
    JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE d.district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM central_bohemia)
    GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2
    ORDER BY crime_count DESC, d.A2 COLLATE NOCASE
    LIMIT 3
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(COUNT(a.account_id)) AS avg_crime_count
    FROM district d
    LEFT JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id
)
SELECT 
    t.district_id,
    t.A2,
    t.crime_count,
    ROUND(t.crime_count, 2) AS avg_top_three_crime_count,
    ROUND(o.avg_crime_count, 2) AS avg_overall_crime_count,
    ROUND(t.crime_count - o.avg_crime_count, 2) AS diff
FROM top_three_districts t, overall_average o;
```

```sql
WITH district_info AS (
    SELECT 
        d.district_id,
        d.A2 AS district_name,
        d.region,
        COUNT(a.account_id) AS num_accounts_opened,
        AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM 
        district d
    JOIN 
        disp disp ON d.district_id = disp.district_id
    JOIN 
        account a ON disp.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    WHERE 
        a.date BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31'
        AND t.date <= '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY 
        d.district_id, d.A2, d.region
),
region_avg_balance AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(avg_balance) AS region_avg
    FROM 
        district_info
)
SELECT 
    district_name,
    num_accounts_opened,
    ROUND(avg_balance, 2) AS avg_balance,
    (SELECT region_avg FROM region_avg_balance) AS region_avg,
    (SELECT district_name FROM district_info ORDER BY avg_balance DESC, district_name ASC LIMIT 1) AS highest_avg_district
FROM 
    district_info
ORDER BY 
    district_name;
```

```sql

  COUNT(b.bond_id) AS bond_count

  bond b
JOIN 
  connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN 
  atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id

  atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
```

```sql
SELECT b.bond_id, b.molecule_id
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
AND b.molecule_id IN (
  SELECT a.molecule_id
  FROM atom a
  WHERE a.element NOT IN (
    SELECT a2.element
    FROM atom a2
    JOIN molecule m2 ON a2.molecule_id = m2.molecule_id
    WHERE m2.label = '+'
  )
```

```sql
SELECT 
    m.molecule_id, 
    COUNT(c.bond_id) AS bond_count
FROM 
    molecule m
JOIN 
    atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
JOIN 
    connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN 
    bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE 
    m.label = '+' 
    AND a.element IN (
        SELECT 
            element 
        FROM 
            atom 
        WHERE 
            molecule_id NOT IN (
                SELECT 
                    molecule_id 
                FROM 
                    molecule 
                WHERE 
                    label = '+'
            )
    )
GROUP BY 
    m.molecule_id
ORDER BY 
    m.molecule_id;
```

```sql
SELECT 
  m.molecule_id,
  m.label,
  COUNT(a.atom_id) AS num_atoms,
  COUNT(b.bond_id) AS num_bonds,
  SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_carbon_atoms,
  SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'Cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_chlorine_atoms,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.bond_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_carbon_touching_bonds,
  SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type IN ('double', 'triple') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_multiple_bonds,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY num_carbon_touching_bonds DESC, num_atoms DESC, m.molecule_id ASC) AS rank
FROM 
  molecule m
LEFT JOIN 
  atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN 
  bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN 
  connected c ON m.molecule_id = c.molecule_id
GROUP BY 
  m.molecule_id, m.label
```
